prompt:
UI design mockup of a screen of an AI software factory console, in its existing "Mission control" design: thin-bordered instrument panels with small corner marks, cyan as the system colour, amber as the one signal that needs a human, monospace for refs, times and figures, a system sans for text, sizes 11 to 18 px, weights 400 and 600 only, everything exact and calm.

Light theme, the warm cream day version: page #f1ece0, panels #f7f3ea, cards #fffdf8, hairlines #d9d4c6, text dark navy #0f1d33, muted #46536a, faint #5b6678, cyan #0a6a80, amber #f0a62a filling buttons with navy text, amber text #8a4f00, the Needs you fill #fff3d6, done green #1c7448, failed red #a14b43.

Three phone screens side by side on a plain neutral background with even gaps, each a flat mobile browser viewport 390 px wide and about 844 px high, no device frame, no notch, no status bar, drawn at high resolution so the text is crisp. They show one long page of the console scrolled to three points, past the chat to the board. On the phone the board is one column of stacked sections, each with its head in small capitals and its count, cards full width, every button at least 44 px high.
Screen 1: a compact top bar "Factory console", "ai-software-factory-code ▾" and a ☰ menu, the status line "● waiting on you · 2 need you · €61.40 / €120.00", then the section "NEEDS YOU 2" with its amber tint, holding cards (1) and (2) in full.
Screen 2: the section "IN PROGRESS 1" with card (6), then the section "QUEUED 3" with cards (3), (4) and the routine ghost card (5).
Screen 3: the section "DONE 3" with cards (7), (8) and (9), then the page's quiet foot.

The cards, words spelled exactly.
NEEDS YOU, oldest first:
(1) Card #1850, waiting 3 h. Title, the ask: Plan "one face" finished, but no test checked its 5 promises. Settle each one. Why line: Until all 5 are settled, the plan stays open and holds production deploys. The promise in view: every card that asks shows one decision block. The suggested answer: "Run the tests now", suggested by the project agent. Other answers: 1. Carousel: 1 of 5.
(2) Card #2101, waiting 8 min. Title, the ask: Change two lines in the runner's build files. Why line: Agents may not push to workflow folders, so this part of plan "criteria gate" needs a human, once #2100 merges. The suggested answer: "I did it", suggested by the planner. Other answers: 2. No carousel.
QUEUED, newest first:
(3) Card #2100, queued 2 h. Title: Narrow the close refusal to plans that hold criteria. Why line: So a plan with no criteria closes without a waiver. Place: plan criteria gate, card 1 of 3, waits for no card.
(4) Card #2102, queued 2 h. Title: Show a plan's promises on its card. Why line: So a human sees what the plan must deliver. Place: plan criteria gate, card 3 of 3, waits for #2101.
(5) At the column's foot, the routine ghost card: title "Update the dependencies" with ↻, why line "So security fixes reach the factory within a week.", schedule "every Monday 06:00 · in 20 min", last run "last #781 merged in 2 days", buttons "Skip once" and "Run now".
IN PROGRESS:
(6) Card #2099, building 12 min, a cyan dot. Title: Fold the agent's own notes in the chat inbox. Why line: So the inbox shows only what a human must read. Place: plan quiet inbox, card 2 of 4.
DONE:
(7) #2011 "Route every ask through the decision block", closed, 1 h 40 min in all.
(8) #2098 "Name each plan in plain words", done, 48 min in all.
(9) #2093 "Retry a refused filing once", failed, 2 h in all.

Direction D, "the labelled rows", for the cards:
Each layer after the title starts with a small label in faint small capitals, so a human who dropped in cold sees what each line is.
A work card (3, 4, 6): row 1, the ref "#2100" in faint mono at the left and "● queued 2 h" in mono at the right. Row 2, the title in 13 px semibold, wrapping, never cut. Row 3, the label "WHY" followed on the same line by the why line in 12.5 px muted grey. Row 4, the label "PLAN" followed by "criteria gate · 1 of 3" in mono 11 px faint. Row 5, the label "WAITS" followed by "no card", on #2102 by "#2101" as a link. #2099 shows "● building 12 min" and "PLAN quiet inbox · 2 of 4" and no WAITS row.
A Needs-you card (1, 2): a 3 px amber bar at the left and an amber band behind the head row, holding "#1850" bold in amber at the left and "3 h" in the muted grey at the right. Then labelled rows: "ASK" with the ask in 15 px semibold, the text colour. "WHY" with the why line. On #1850 "PROMISE" with "every card that asks shows one decision block." "ANSWER" with an amber button "Run the tests now", "by the project agent" in faint grey under the button and "+ 1 other answer" as a cyan link beside it. The carousel row "‹ 1 of 5 ›" at the card's foot under a hairline. #2101 the same with "I did it", "by the planner" and "+ 2 other answers", no carousel. 12 px between the two cards.
A Done card (7, 8, 9): two quiet lines, no labels. "#2011" in faint mono, then the title in muted grey. Then "closed · 1 h 40 min" in faint mono, the state word in its quiet hue.
The routine ghost card (5): a 1 px dashed border, no fill, faint. "↻ Update the dependencies", then "WHY So security fixes reach the factory within a week.", then "WHEN every Monday 06:00 · in 20 min", then "LAST #781 merged in 2 days", then two small ghost buttons "Skip once" and "Run now".

Legible UI text with exact spelling. Every word above appears once, where it is placed. Nothing invented, no lorem ipsum, no extra cards, buttons or labels. Normal states whisper, exceptional states speak: the Needs you cards and their amber answer buttons are the loudest things on the screen, queued and in progress cards are quiet, done cards are the quietest. Made by a top product design studio. Not a template, not a generic admin dashboard.
